game.name: Skylanders : Spyro's Adventure (Russia)
game.desc: Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure is an action-adventure game for Xbox 360. You can play as about thirty creatures by controlling figurines that you have to position on a base supplied with the game. Three of them are also included and the others can be purchased separately. In addition, there are two modes to play in cooperation with a friend or to face an opponent.
